leads.prompt:
[Format] 9:16 vertical, 15s, cinematic fashion editorial, surreal Gucci-style, moonlit greenhouse, deep navy + rust + gold palette, 35mm film grain. No music.
[Subject] A model in Trademart's signature piece stands in a moonlit marble greenhouse; the fabric slowly ripples into liquid silk and blooming vines, gold dust drifting.
[Style] high-fashion editorial, soft moonlight with warm gold rim light, shallow depth of field, slow elegant motion, luxurious textures.
[Timeline]
0-3s: slow push-in, establishing the moonlit greenhouse, the Trademart product glints in the dark.
3-7s: model enters frame, camera orbits slowly; fabric transforms into flowing vines and back.
7-11s: macro detail of the product, texture and light, petals and gold dust drifting.
11-15s: pull back to a symmetrical hero shot, model holds still, product centered, space at the bottom for logo.
[Camera] smooth gimbal, slow orbit, macro inserts, no shaky cam.
[Avoid] text artifacts, extra fingers, distorted logo, music.
